item.spicedcider.ruined_page.text.1:
§3I see the player you mean.
§2PLAYERNAME?
§3Yes. Take care. It has reached a higher level now. It can read our thoughts.
§2That doesn't matter. It thinks we are part of the game.
§3I like this player. It played well. It did not give up.
§2It is reading our thoughts as though they were words on a screen.
item.spicedcider.ruined_page.text.10:
§3Too strong for this dream. To tell them how to live is to prevent them living.
§2I will not tell the player how to live.
§3The player is growing restless.
§2I will tell the player a story.
§3But not the truth.
item.spicedcider.ruined_page.text.11:
§2No. A story that contains the truth safely, in a cage of words. Not the naked truth that can burn over any distance.
§3Give it a body, again.
§2Yes. Player...
§3Use its name.
§2PLAYERNAME. Player of games.
§3Good.
item.spicedcider.ruined_page.text.12: §2Take a breath, now. Take another. Feel air in your lungs. Let your limbs return. Yes, move your fingers. Have a body again, under gravity, in air. Respawn in the long dream. There you are. Your body touching the universe again at every point, as though you were separate things. As though we were separate things.
item.spicedcider.ruined_page.text.13: §3Who are we? Once we were called the spirit of the mountain. Father sun, mother moon. Ancestral spirits, animal spirits. Jinn. Ghosts. The green man. Then gods, demons. Angels. Poltergeists. Aliens, extraterrestrials. Leptons, quarks. The words change. We do not change.
item.spicedcider.ruined_page.text.14: §2We are the universe. We are everything you think isn't you. You are looking at us now, through your skin and your eyes. And why does the universe touch your skin, and throw light on you? To see you, player. To know you. And to be known. I shall tell you a story.
item.spicedcider.ruined_page.text.15:
§2Once upon a time, there was a player.
§3The player was you, PLAYERNAME.
item.spicedcider.ruined_page.text.16: §2Sometimes it thought itself human, on the thin crust of a spinning globe of molten rock. The ball of molten rock circled a ball of blazing gas that was three hundred and thirty thousand times more massive than it. They were so far apart that light took eight minutes to cross the gap. The light was information from a star, and it could burn your skin from a hundred and fifty million kilometres away.
item.spicedcider.ruined_page.text.17:
§2Sometimes the player dreamed it was a miner, on the surface of a world that was flat, and infinite. The sun was a square of white. The days were short; there was much to do; and death was a temporary inconvenience.
§3Sometimes the player dreamed it was lost in a story.
item.spicedcider.ruined_page.text.18:
§2Sometimes the player dreamed it was other things, in other places. Sometimes these dreams were disturbing. Sometimes very beautiful indeed. Sometimes the player woke from one dream into another, then woke from that into a third.
§3Sometimes the player dreamed it watched words on a screen.
§2Let's go back.
item.spicedcider.ruined_page.text.19:
§2The atoms of the player were scattered in the grass, in the rivers, in the air, in the ground. A woman gathered the atoms; she drank and ate and inhaled; and the woman assembled the player, in her body.
§2And the player awoke, from the warm, dark world of its mother's body, into the long dream.
item.spicedcider.ruined_page.text.2:
§3That is how it chooses to imagine many things, when it is deep in the dream of a game.
§2Words make a wonderful interface. Very flexible. And less terrifying than staring at the reality behind the screen.
item.spicedcider.ruined_page.text.20: §2And the player was a new story, never told before, written in letters of DNA. And the player was a new program, never run before, generated by a sourcecode a billion years old. And the player was a new human, never alive before, made from nothing but milk and love.
item.spicedcider.ruined_page.text.21:
§3You are the player. The story. The program. The human. Made from nothing but milk and love.
§2Let's go further back.
item.spicedcider.ruined_page.text.22: §2The seven billion billion billion atoms of the player's body were created, long before this game, in the heart of a star. So the player, too, is information from a star. And the player moves through a story, which is a forest of information planted by a man called Julian, on a flat, infinite world created by a man called Markus, that exists inside a small, private world created by the player, who inhabits a universe created by...
item.spicedcider.ruined_page.text.23: §3Shush. Sometimes the player created a small, private world that was soft and warm and simple. Sometimes hard, and cold, and complicated. Sometimes it built a model of the universe in its head; flecks of energy, moving through vast empty spaces. Sometimes it called those flecks "electrons" and "protons".
item.spicedcider.ruined_page.text.24:
§2Sometimes it called them "planets" and "stars".
§2Sometimes it believed it was in a universe that was made of energy that was made of offs and ons; zeros and ones; lines of code. Sometimes it believed it was playing a game. Sometimes it believed it was reading words on a screen.
§3You are the player, reading words...
item.spicedcider.ruined_page.text.25: §2Shush... Sometimes the player read lines of code on a screen. Decoded them into words; decoded words into meaning; decoded meaning into feelings, emotions, theories, ideas, and the player started to breathe faster and deeper and realised it was alive, it was alive, those thousand deaths had not been real, the player was alive
item.spicedcider.ruined_page.text.26:
§3You. You. You are alive.
§2and sometimes the player believed the universe had spoken to it through the sunlight that came through the shuffling leaves of the summer trees
item.spicedcider.ruined_page.text.27: §3and sometimes the player believed the universe had spoken to it through the light that fell from the crisp night sky of winter, where a fleck of light in the corner of the player's eye might be a star a million times as massive as the sun, boiling its planets to plasma in order to be visible for a moment to the player, walking home at the far side of the universe, suddenly smelling food, almost at the familiar door, about to dream again
item.spicedcider.ruined_page.text.28:
§2and sometimes the player believed the universe had spoken to it through the zeros and ones, through the electricity of the world, through the scrolling words on a screen at the end of a dream
§3and the universe said I love you
§2and the universe said you have played the game well
item.spicedcider.ruined_page.text.29:
§3and the universe said everything you need is within you
§2and the universe said you are stronger than you know
§3and the universe said you are the daylight
§2and the universe said you are the night
§3and the universe said the darkness you fight is within you
item.spicedcider.ruined_page.text.3:
§3They used to hear voices. Before players could read. Back in the days when those who did not play called the players witches, and warlocks. And players dreamed they flew through the air, on sticks powered by demons.
§2What did this player dream?
item.spicedcider.ruined_page.text.30:
§2and the universe said the light you seek is within you
§3and the universe said you are not alone
§2and the universe said you are not separate from every other thing
§3and the universe said you are the universe tasting itself, talking to itself, reading its own code
item.spicedcider.ruined_page.text.31:
§2and the universe said I love you because you are love.
§3And the game was over and the player woke up from the dream. And the player began a new dream. And the player dreamed again, dreamed better. And the player was the universe. And the player was love.
§3You are the player.
§2Wake up.
item.spicedcider.ruined_page.text.4: §3This player dreamed of sunlight and trees. Of fire and water. It dreamed it created. And it dreamed it destroyed. It dreamed it hunted, and was hunted. It dreamed of shelter.
item.spicedcider.ruined_page.text.5:
§2Hah, the original interface. A million years old, and it still works. But what true structure did this player create, in the reality behind the screen?
§3It worked, with a million others, to sculpt a true world in a fold of the §f§k§a§b§3, and created a §f§k§a§b§3 for §f§k§a§b§3, in the §f§k§a§b§3.
§2It cannot read that thought.
item.spicedcider.ruined_page.text.6:
§3No. It has not yet achieved the highest level. That, it must achieve in the long dream of life, not the short dream of a game.
§2Does it know that we love it? That the universe is kind?
§3Sometimes, through the noise of its thoughts, it hears the universe, yes.
item.spicedcider.ruined_page.text.7:
§2But there are times it is sad, in the long dream. It creates worlds that have no summer, and it shivers under a black sun, and it takes its sad creation for reality.
§3To cure it of sorrow would destroy it. The sorrow is part of its own private task. We cannot interfere.
item.spicedcider.ruined_page.text.8:
§2Sometimes when they are deep in dreams, I want to tell them, they are building true worlds in reality. Sometimes I want to tell them of their importance to the universe. Sometimes, when they have not made a true connection in a while, I want to help them to speak the word they fear.
§3It reads our thoughts.
item.spicedcider.ruined_page.text.9:
§2Sometimes I do not care. Sometimes I wish to tell them, this world you take for truth is merely §f§k§a§b§2 and §f§k§a§b§2, I wish to tell them that they are §f§k§a§b§2 in the §f§k§a§b§2. They see so little of reality, in their long dream.
§3And yet they play the game.
§2But it would be so easy to tell them...
item.spicedcider.sticky_grappling_hook.d: Good for climbing, not fishing. Adheres to walls rather than bouncing off them.
option.spicedcider.bedExplosionPreventio: Beds don't explode outside the Overworld; instead they show a message and wake sleeping villagers.
Registers Every Compat wood-type variants (seats, palisades) for The Block Box. Requires The Block Box, Every Compat, and Moonlight Lib. Requires a restart to take effect.
option.spicedcider.caveMaps.tooltip: Maps in the Nether and other dimensions with a ceiling show the terrain at a usable height instead of the bedrock roof.
option.spicedcider.caveMapsCreationHeigh: Dimension ids where maps always show the height they were created at, even without a ceiling.
option.spicedcider.caveMapsFixedHeight.t: Height maps show in dimensions with a ceiling when Use Map Creation Height is off.
Entries like minecraft:the_nether=40. Maps in these dimensions always show this height, overriding the other settings.
option.spicedcider.caveMapsUseCreationHe: In dimensions with a ceiling, maps show the terrain at the height where they were created. When off, the fixed height is used.
option.spicedcider.cloudCoverCommandFade: How many seconds clouds take to fade when the weather is changed with /weather. 0 switches instantly.
option.spicedcider.cloudCoverFadeSeconds: How many seconds clouds take to fade between cloud cover states when the weather changes naturally.
option.spicedcider.customDeathSound.tool: Plays C418 - Death when you die.
option.spicedcider.customOptionsScreen.t: Replace the vanilla Options screen with Spiced Cider's single settings screen (sidebar pages, curated options). Keybinds the screen hides are unbound.
option.spicedcider.customWindowTitle.too: Customize the OS window title bar text.
option.spicedcider.customWindowIcon.tool: Uses the pack's own window and taskbar icon on Windows, including during loading. Requires a restart to take effect.
option.spicedcider.disableRecipeBookTrac: Disables recipe book unlock tracking/saving/syncing entirely and skips loading recipe unlock advancements. Saves memory and disk I/O.
option.spicedcider.endCrystalHealing.too: End crystals with no beam target heal nearby damaged entities and render a beam to their heal target.
option.spicedcider.endCrystalPlaceAnywhe: End crystals can be placed on any block, not just obsidian/bedrock.
option.spicedcider.keepBrokenItems.toolt: Tools, armor, and elytra become "Broken" instead of being destroyed when they run out of durability.
option.spicedcider.brokenToolsOnCuttingB: Broken tools can still be used to cut ingredients on cutting boards.
option.spicedcider.lodGeneration.tooltip: Generates terrain beyond your render distance in the background so it can be drawn in the distance, out to your Distant Terrain Range. The chunks are never saved, so the world folder doesn't grow.
option.spicedcider.lodGenerationMaxRadiu: Server-side cap, in chunks, on how far LoD terrain is generated around each player. Each player's own Voxy LoD render distance is used up to this limit.
option.spicedcider.lodGenerationSendRate: Chunks per second sent to each player on a server. Singleplayer hands chunks to Voxy directly and ignores this.
Worker threads used to generate distant terrain. 0 picks automatically: an eighth of your CPU threads, between 1 and 4. More is faster but costs frame rate while terrain is generating. Requires rejoining the world.
Hides the arrow depth line (Shallow hit, Lodged, Deep lodged) from Lodged's inventory arrow tooltip. Requires Lodged.
option.spicedcider.lodgedHideBleedingRis: Hides the Bleeding risk line from Lodged's inventory arrow tooltip. Requires Lodged.
option.spicedcider.netherAmbientTint.too: How strongly dark areas of the Nether take on the colour of the biome's air. 0% keeps the vanilla shadows.
option.spicedcider.netherHeatHaze.toolti: Distant terrain in the Nether shimmers in the heat, more strongly and closer up near lava. Also scaled by the Distortion Effects accessibility option.
option.spicedcider.netherMist.tooltip: Faint drifting mist in the Nether air, tinted by the biome. Follows the Particles setting.
option.spicedcider.oldProgressScreen.too: Restore classic style loading/progress screen when loading worlds, saving worlds, or changing dimensions.
option.spicedcider.oldWisteriaTrees.tool: Use Environmental's old 1.19 wisteria tree leaf generation instead of the current sparse/patchy one. Requires Environmental (obviously).
option.spicedcider.randomWorldNaming.too: Auto-generates a random world name on the world creation screen, with a reroll button if Modern World Creation is present.
option.spicedcider.removeQuasiConnectivi: Removes quasi-connectivity from pistons, dispensers, and droppers.
option.spicedcider.respawnAnchorExplosio: Respawn anchors don't explode outside dimensions where they work; instead they show a message.
Leaves from every mod never suffocate or block vision, like vanilla leaves. Requires a restart to take effect.
option.spicedcider.torchflowerLight.tool: Torchflowers and potted torchflowers give off light. Requires a restart to take effect.
option.spicedcider.drinkIntoxication.too: Ciders, wines and meads make you Intoxicated. Requires Cultural Delights. Requires a restart to take effect.
option.spicedcider.tideSpawnEggs.tooltip: Gives Tide's fish spawn eggs classic two-tone spawn egg icons colored after each fish. Requires Tide. Requires a restart to take effect.
option.spicedcider.sulfurCavesRework.too: Sulfur Caves are lined with sulfur and edged with tuff instead of bands of cinnabar and stone. Requires Vanilla Backport. Only affects newly generated terrain. Requires a restart to take effect.
option.spicedcider.harmlessGhastFireball: Ghast fireballs no longer destroy blocks.
option.spicedcider.logsNeedAxe.tooltip: Blocks tagged spicedcider:needs_axe_to_harvest (logs) only drop when broken with an axe.
option.spicedcider.treeBark.tooltip: Stripping a log with an axe drops Tree Bark, which can be used on a stripped log to restore it.
option.spicedcider.mossNeedsHoe.tooltip: Blocks tagged spicedcider:needs_hoe_to_harvest (moss) only drop when broken with a hoe.
option.spicedcider.blockDyeing.tooltip: Use a dye on a placed colored block to recolor it.
option.spicedcider.composterWorms.toolti: Emptying a composter sometimes pops out worms.
Azaleas can no longer be bonemealed into trees.
option.spicedcider.zombieTorches.tooltip: Zombies sometimes spawn holding a torch.
option.spicedcider.piglinWeaponSwap.tool: Piglins spawn with Piglin Broadswords and Battleaxes instead of golden swords and axes.
Soul campfires haunt items using Create's haunting recipes. Requires Create.
option.spicedcider.throwablePotionCooldo: Splash potions have a 10 second cooldown and lingering potions a 5 second cooldown.
Sign hitboxes follow the sign's model and rotation.
option.spicedcider.parallelLocate.toolti: Runs /locate biome searches, structure locating and map biome previews across several threads.
option.spicedcider.skeletonHealthNerf.to: Skeletons and strays get 12 max health. Requires a restart to take effect.
option.spicedcider.renameRecipe.tooltip: Combine a named name tag with an item in the crafting grid to rename it. Takes effect after /reload.
option.spicedcider.waterloggableRedstone: Repeaters, comparators and other diodes can be placed in water.
option.spicedcider.cloudCover.tooltip: Overworld skies cycle between clear, mostly clear, partly cloudy and cloudy, and cloud over before rain. Adds the extra /weather states. Requires a restart to add or remove the commands.
option.spicedcider.monumentChests.toolti: Newly generated ocean monuments hold chests of loot.
option.spicedcider.ruinedPages.tooltip: Pages of the End Poem turn up in dungeon chests and archaeology loot. Takes effect after /reload.
option.spicedcider.balloons.tooltip: Balloons can be crafted and dyed. Takes effect after /reload.
option.spicedcider.pocketJukebox.tooltip: The Pocket Jukebox can be crafted and dyed. Takes effect after /reload.
option.spicedcider.grapplingHooks.toolti: Grappling Hooks can be crafted. Requires Tide. Takes effect after /reload.
option.spicedcider.strawGolems.tooltip: Straw Golems can be built from a hay bale and a carved pumpkin.
option.spicedcider.sputters.tooltip: Sputters can be built from a barrel and a carved pumpkin.
option.spicedcider.leafSticks.tooltip: Breaking leaves sometimes drops a stick. Takes effect after /reload.
option.spicedcider.fireStriker.tooltip: Two flint craft a single-use Fire Striker. Takes effect after /reload.
option.spicedcider.deposits.tooltip: Deposit ores generate underground, and geodes turn up in dungeon and Nether chests. Worldgen changes need a world restart and only affect new chunks.
option.spicedcider.wormyDirt.tooltip: Wormy dirt generates underground. Needs a world restart and only affects new chunks.
option.spicedcider.fruitTrees.tooltip: Cacao and pear trees generate in the world. Needs a world restart and only affects new chunks.
option.spicedcider.oceanDepths.tooltip: Algae, chromarine and achromarine reefs and brambles, and hydrothermal vents generate in oceans. Needs a world restart and only affects new chunks.
option.spicedcider.buildingBlocks.toolti: Recipes for the extra stairs, slabs, walls and other building blocks. Takes effect after /reload.
option.spicedcider.paleGardenPlants.tool: Pale pumpkins, pale roses and pale bushes grow in pale gardens. Requires Vanilla Backport. Only affects newly generated terrain.
option.spicedcider.snifferGoldenDandelio: Sniffers can dig up golden dandelions. Requires Tiny Takeover Backport. Takes effect after /reload.
category.spicedcider.features.tooltip: Additive features that can be switched off individually. Their items and blocks stay registered.
option.spicedcider.clutterNoMoreShapeWhe: Replaces Clutter No More's scrolling shape switcher with a radial wheel, and makes the controller shape button hold-to-open. Requires Clutter No More.
option.spicedcider.backpackInventoryRows: A worn backpack adds its 27 slots to the player inventory screen, and a backpack with items in it can't be taken off or placed from your back. Client and server must match. Requires Reliable Backpacks.
option.spicedcider.backpackAcceptAnythin: Removes the backpack item filter, so backpacks can hold any item. Requires Reliable Backpacks.
option.spicedcider.incrementalMiningVani: Incremental Mining uses the normal block breaking time instead of its own. Requires Incremental Mining.
option.spicedcider.dustBunnySpawners.too: Half of the mineshaft side-room dungeon spawners spawn dust bunnies. Requires YUNG's Better Mineshafts and Spelunkery. Only affects newly generated terrain.
option.spicedcider.tapRedstone.tooltip: A change in redstone power opens or closes a tap. Requires No Man's Land.
option.spicedcider.tapFaucetFluids.toolt: Taps drain and fill everything a Supplementaries faucet can, such as jars, beehives and modded cauldrons, and show a stream of liquid while pouring. Requires No Man's Land and Supplementaries.
option.spicedcider.pineconesOnTrees.tool: Trees with pinecone-growing logs generate with pinecones. Requires Environmental. Only affects newly generated terrain.
option.spicedcider.copperGolemNoChest.to: Building a copper golem doesn't leave a copper chest behind. Requires Vanilla Backport.
option.spicedcider.vanillaBackportLightT: Awake creaking hearts and resin clumps give off light, creaking eyes always glow, and eyeblossoms open in dim light at any time of day. Requires Vanilla Backport.
option.spicedcider.creakingBuff.tooltip: The creaking moves a little faster and hits twice as hard. Requires Vanilla Backport.
option.spicedcider.goldenDandelionTempti: Baby animals that are still growing follow players holding a golden dandelion. Requires Tiny Takeover Backport.
option.spicedcider.goldenDandelionPartic: Golden dandelions give off drifting golden specks. Requires Tiny Takeover Backport.
option.spicedcider.brightCageLanterns.to: Lit cage lanterns give off full light. Requires Architect's Palette. Requires a restart to take effect.
option.spicedcider.oceanRuinPrismarineCh: Ocean ruins generate prismarine chests instead of regular chests. Requires Quark. Only affects newly generated terrain.
option.spicedcider.noVanillaCocoaPods.to: Cocoa pods can't be placed and break off logs. Cacao trees grow their own pods.
option.spicedcider.paleOakGrowsGloomwood: Pale oak saplings grow into thin gloomwood trees, and don't grow as 2x2 trees.
option.spicedcider.remiRightSideTabs.too: When the creative tab panel is on the right side of the item list, its tabs are drawn on the right edge too. Requires REMI.
option.spicedcider.emiHideSmithingCatego: Removes the smithing table category from EMI. Requires EMI.
option.spicedcider.emiCreateFanRework.to: EMI shows haunting under a soul campfire instead of an encased fan, and hides the fan washing, smoking and blasting categories. Requires EMI and Create.
option.spicedcider.createHideItemDescrip: Hides the hold-shift item descriptions Create adds to item tooltips. Requires Create.
option.spicedcider.quarkHideHints.toolti: Hides the item information pages Quark adds to the recipe viewer. Requires Quark.
option.spicedcider.carvingWheel.tooltip: Replaces No Man's Land's carving menu with a radial wheel. Requires No Man's Land.
option.spicedcider.anvilHideNameField.to: Removes the rename text field from the anvil screen.
option.spicedcider.bedScreenTips.tooltip: While sleeping, the chat box is replaced by gameplay tips.
Moves the recipe book button in the inventory screen to the right, beside the crafting grid.
option.spicedcider.hideOwnEffectParticle: Hides your own potion effect particles in first person.
option.spicedcider.softerBlindnessAndDar: Blindness fog reaches farther and the Darkness pulse is weaker, so both stay playable at night and underground.
option.spicedcider.hideSmithingTemplateT: Removes the "Applies to" and "Ingredients" lines from smithing template tooltips.
option.spicedcider.slimeTimeDisableItemM: Disables Slime Time's feature where clicking slimeballs together in inventory merges them. Requires Slime Time.
option.spicedcider.easyAnvilsFreeRepairs: Anvil repairs and renames cost no experience. Requires Easy Anvils.
option.spicedcider.fireRingNoPotions.too: Fire rings no longer take potions to spread their effects. Requires Piglin Proliferation.
option.spicedcider.copperGolemBuildingDi: Stops copper golems from being built out of blocks. Requires Caverns & Chasms.
option.spicedcider.whereWindsBlowNoBonem: Bonemeal no longer turns grass into overgrown grass. Requires Where Winds Blow.
option.spicedcider.voiceChatHideSinglepl: Hide Voice Chat HUD in Singleplayer
Hides the voice chat HUD while playing in a world that isn't open to LAN. Requires Simple Voice Chat.
option.spicedcider.emiTappingCategory.to: Adds an EMI category for tapping trees with a tap. Requires EMI and No Man's Land. Reload EMI or rejoin the world to apply.
option.spicedcider.emiSluicingCategory.t: Adds an EMI category for what sluices filter out of each fluid. Requires EMI and Spelunkery. Reload EMI or rejoin the world to apply.
Adds an EMI category for what piglins give in exchange for gold. Requires EMI. Reload EMI or rejoin the world to apply.
option.spicedcider.emiSniffingCategory.t: Adds an EMI category for what sniffers dig up. Requires EMI. Reload EMI or rejoin the world to apply.
option.spicedcider.emiArchaeologyCategor: Adds an EMI category for what brushing suspicious blocks can uncover. Requires EMI. Reload EMI or rejoin the world to apply.
option.spicedcider.emiStructureLootCateg: Adds an EMI category for the loot found in each structure's chests. Requires EMI. Reload EMI or rejoin the world to apply.
option.spicedcider.spiderRangedWebAttack: Spiders switch to shooting cobweb projectiles at range when their target is trapped.
option.spicedcider.sunDogs.tooltip: Show the rare halos of light that sometimes form on either side of the sun.
option.spicedcider.unifiedPetArmor.toolt: Horse armor works like wolf armor: it tanks the hit, loses durability, and is repaired by right-clicking the pet with the armor's material. Applies to horses and, with wolvesWearAnyArmor, to wolves. Requires a restart to take effect.
option.spicedcider.unmineableBlockSparks: Spawns sparks, plays hit sounds, and displays a warning message when attempting to mine a block that requires a stronger tool.
option.spicedcider.vistaMirrorFog.toolti: Draws thick fog inside mirror reflections and TV feeds, scaled to the mirror reflection distance, so the shortened view fades out instead of ending abruptly. Requires Mirror Performance Fixes.
option.spicedcider.vistaMirrorFogEnd.too: Distance where mirror fog becomes fully opaque, as a percentage of the mirror reflection distance.
option.spicedcider.vistaMirrorFogStart.t: Distance where mirror fog begins, as a percentage of the mirror reflection distance.
Applies performance fixes to Vista's mirror/TV reflection rendering (better culling, better shared-states, re-render throttling). Requires Vista (obviously).
option.spicedcider.vistaMirrorReflection: Max distance in blocks that terrain and entities render to inside a mirror reflection. Only lowers Vista's own television.render_distance (which affects TVs and mirrors). Does not affect TV live feeds.
option.spicedcider.voidWater.tooltip: Fluids at the bottom of the world spill into the void as fading trails you can swim in. Takes effect when a world is next loaded.
option.spicedcider.voidWaterExcludedDime: Dimension ids where fluids never spill into the void. The End is excluded by default because its floor is a sea of Dimensional Tears.
option.spicedcider.voidWaterTrailDecay.t: How quickly void fluid trails fade out. Higher values fade faster.
How many blocks fluid trails extend below the bottom of the world.
option.spicedcider.voxyCaveFogDensity.to: How much closer the fog gets when you are underground, away from the sky. 0% disables cave fog.
option.spicedcider.voxyFogEnd.tooltip: Distance where the fog becomes fully opaque, as a percentage of the Voxy LoD render distance (or the normal render distance if Voxy is not rendering).
option.spicedcider.voxyFogOverride.toolt: Replaces the terrain fog with configurable start and end distances that cover Voxy's LoD terrain, plus weather and cave fog. Disable to use Roxy's own fog.
option.spicedcider.voxyFogStart.tooltip: Distance where the fog begins, as a percentage of the Voxy LoD render distance (or the normal render distance if Voxy is not rendering).
How much closer the fog gets in the Nether's hazy air. 0% matches the Overworld.
option.spicedcider.voxyWeatherFogDensity: How much closer the fog gets during rain, snow and thunderstorms. Thunderstorms count for twice as much as rain. 0% disables weather fog.
option.spicedcider.windowTitleFormat.too: Format string for the OS window title. %v will be replaced with the current Minecraft version.
option.spicedcider.wolvesWearAnyArmor.to: Tamed wolves can be equipped with horse/animal armor as body armor.
spicedcider.emi.brewing.lingering: Makes the brew a Lingering Potion
spicedcider.emi.brewing.splash: Makes the brew a Splash Potion
spicedcider.options.aurora.tooltip: Ribbons of coloured light ripple across the night sky in cold biomes.
spicedcider.options.controller.swap_ab.t: Swap the bottom and right face buttons, like a Nintendo layout.
spicedcider.options.controller.swap_shou: Swap the shoulder bumpers with the triggers, so attacking and using items move to the bumpers.
spicedcider.options.controller.swap_xy.t: Swap the left and top face buttons.
spicedcider.options.controller.vibration: Rumble the controller when taking damage, breaking blocks and other events.
spicedcider.options.custom_stars.tooltip: Fills the night sky with twinkling stars of varied sizes and colours.
spicedcider.options.dynamic_lights.toolt: Lets held torches and glowing mobs light up their surroundings. Faster modes update less often.
spicedcider.options.fog_end.tooltip: How far away the fog becomes fully opaque, as a share of the Distant Terrain Range. Lower values hide distant terrain sooner.
spicedcider.options.fog_start.tooltip: How far away the fog begins, as a share of the Distant Terrain Range. Below 0% the haze starts building right in front of you, so even nearby terrain is slightly fogged.
spicedcider.options.heat_haze.tooltip: Distant terrain in the Nether shimmers in the heat, more strongly near lava. Turn off if screen distortion bothers you.
spicedcider.options.inverted_bell_blur.t: Blurs the screen while teleporting with an Inverted Bell.
spicedcider.options.nether_mist.tooltip: Large banks of faint mist drift through the Nether's air in the distance.
spicedcider.options.nether_tint.tooltip: How strongly dark areas of the Nether take on the colour of the biome's air. 0% keeps the vanilla shadows.
spicedcider.options.shooting_stars.toolt: Stars occasionally streak across the night sky.
spicedcider.options.sun_dogs.tooltip: Rare halos of light that sometimes form on either side of the sun.
spicedcider.options.title: Settings
spicedcider.ponder.beacon.text_1: A Beacon sits on top of a pyramid of mineral blocks
spicedcider.ponder.beacon.text_2: Blocks of Iron, Gold, Diamond and other metals can be mixed freely
spicedcider.ponder.beacon.text_3: Each layer is two blocks wider than the one above, and every extra layer unlocks stronger effects
spicedcider.ponder.beacon.text_4: A full pyramid has four layers, the bottom one 9 by 9 blocks
spicedcider.ponder.beacon.text_5: The beacon needs a clear view of the sky
spicedcider.ponder.beacon.text_6: Right-click it and pay with an ingot or a Diamond to choose its effects
spicedcider.ponder.cauldron_brewing.head: Brewing Potions in a Cauldron
spicedcider.ponder.cauldron_brewing.text: Cauldrons brew potions while there is heat right below them
Arrows dipped into the brew come out as Tipped Arrows
Ingredients of different kinds taint the brew, and the Cauldron takes nothing more until it is emptied
Campfires, Fire and Magma Blocks all give heat
Add Nether Wart to a Cauldron of Water to make a Clear Potion
Each ingredient turns the Clear Potion into the potion it belongs to
More ingredients of the same kind make it last longer and grow stronger, up to five in total
Ingredients can be thrown in or added with a right-click
Fill Glass Bottles from the Cauldron, three in total
Gunpowder turns the brew into Splash Potions
Creeper Spores turn it into Lingering Potions instead
spicedcider.ponder.comparator_containers: A Comparator can measure how full the block behind it is
Even a single item gives a signal of 1
The fuller it gets, the stronger the signal, up to 15 when completely full
Comparators also read Cauldrons, Composters, Cakes, Jukeboxes, Lecterns and more
spicedcider.ponder.comparator_modes.head: Comparing and subtracting signals
spicedcider.ponder.comparator_modes.text: Comparators pass the signal from their back out of their front
In compare mode, the output stays on while the back is at least as strong as both sides
Right-click to switch to subtract mode: the strongest side is taken away from the back
Here 15 minus 14 leaves a signal of 1, which fades out before it reaches the lamp
spicedcider.ponder.conduit.text_1: A Conduit needs a frame of Prismarine blocks around it
spicedcider.ponder.conduit.text_2: Frame blocks go in 5 by 5 rings centered on it; 16 is enough to activate it
spicedcider.ponder.conduit.text_3: Prismarine, Prismarine Bricks, Dark Prismarine and Sea Lanterns all count
spicedcider.ponder.conduit.text_4: The conduit and every block touching it have to be water
spicedcider.ponder.conduit.text_5: Players in water nearby get Conduit Power; every 7 frame blocks add 16 blocks of range
spicedcider.ponder.conduit.text_6: With all 42 frame blocks, it also attacks hostile mobs close by
spicedcider.ponder.cooking_pot_heat.head: Heating the Cooking Pot
spicedcider.ponder.cooking_pot_heat.text: The Cooking Pot only cooks while there is heat right below it
Stoves, Campfires, Fire, Lava and Magma Blocks all give heat
Over a Campfire or open fire, it rests on a tray
A Hopper between the heat and the pot passes the heat up
The Skillet uses heat the same way
spicedcider.ponder.copper_golem.text_1: A Block of Copper topped with a Carved Pumpkin makes a Copper Golem
spicedcider.ponder.copper_golem.text_2: Like copper blocks, Copper Golems slowly oxidize
spicedcider.ponder.copper_golem.text_3: A fully oxidized golem may freeze into a statue
spicedcider.ponder.copper_golem.text_4: Wax it with Honeycomb to stop the aging, or scrape it back with an Axe
Copper Golems carry items out of Copper Chests
Each item goes into a nearby chest that already holds the same item...
...or into an empty chest when nothing matches
spicedcider.ponder.crafter.text_1: The Crafter holds a crafting grid and crafts on its own
spicedcider.ponder.crafter.text_2: Hoppers and Droppers can fill it; each item goes to the slot holding the fewest
spicedcider.ponder.crafter.text_3: Click a slot in its menu to disable it, keeping the recipe's shape intact
spicedcider.ponder.crafter.text_4: A flux pulse makes it craft, pushing the result out of its front
spicedcider.ponder.crafter.text_5: A Comparator reads how many of its slots are filled or disabled
spicedcider.ponder.daylight_detector.hea: Sensing the sun with Daylight Detectors
spicedcider.ponder.daylight_detector.tex: Daylight Detectors give off a signal based on how bright the sky is
The signal is strongest around noon and fades away towards night
Right-click it to invert it, so it measures darkness instead
spicedcider.ponder.dripstone_farm.text_1: Pointed Dripstone hanging under a block drips whatever fluid sits on top of that block
spicedcider.ponder.dripstone_farm.text_2: Place a Cauldron below the tip to catch the drips
spicedcider.ponder.dripstone_farm.text_3: Water fills the Cauldron one level at a time
spicedcider.ponder.dripstone_farm.text_4: Lava drips far more slowly, but fills the Cauldron in one go
spicedcider.ponder.dripstone_farm.text_5: The Cauldron can sit up to 10 blocks below the tip
spicedcider.ponder.film_developing.text_: Film has to be developed before its photographs can be printed
A Spout develops black and white film with Water
Colour film is developed with a Clear Potion
Film can also be developed by crafting it together with the same potion
spicedcider.ponder.gingerbread_golem.tex: Stick a Gumdrop on the front of a Gingerbread block
A Carved Pumpkin on top, facing the same way as the Gumdrop, brings a Gingerbread Golem to life
Sneak and right-click to make it sit or stand
Gingerbread Cookies heal it and patch up its bites
spicedcider.ponder.hopper.text_1: Hoppers catch items dropped on top and pass them into the block they point at
spicedcider.ponder.hopper.text_2: They also pull items out of containers above them
spicedcider.ponder.hopper.text_3: Place a hopper against the side of a block to point its spout that way instead
spicedcider.ponder.hopper.text_4: A flux signal locks the hopper, stopping it from moving anything
spicedcider.ponder.iron_golem.text_1: Four Blocks of Iron in a T shape form the body
spicedcider.ponder.iron_golem.text_2: The spaces beside the bottom block have to stay empty
spicedcider.ponder.iron_golem.text_3: A Carved Pumpkin or Jack o'Lantern placed on top last brings it to life
spicedcider.ponder.iron_golem.text_4: A built Iron Golem fights nearby monsters and never attacks players
spicedcider.ponder.iron_golem.text_5: Hand it Iron Ingots to patch up its cracks
spicedcider.ponder.lightroom.text_1: The Lightroom prints Photographs from developed film
spicedcider.ponder.lightroom.text_2: It only works in bright light, so keep a light source right next to it
spicedcider.ponder.lightroom.text_3: Load developed film, then add Paper and Black Dye for black and white prints
spicedcider.ponder.lightroom.text_4: Colour prints also need Cyan, Magenta and Yellow Dye
spicedcider.ponder.lightroom.text_5: Pick a frame and press Print
spicedcider.ponder.lightroom.text_6: Once printing is done, the Photograph is ready to take out
spicedcider.ponder.nether_portal.text_1: A ring of Obsidian at least 4 wide and 5 tall makes a Nether Portal frame
spicedcider.ponder.nether_portal.text_3: Use a Dimensional Tears Bottle on the inside of the frame to tear it open
spicedcider.ponder.nether_portal.text_4: Every Ruined Portal has a bottle waiting in its chest
spicedcider.ponder.nether_portal.text_5: More Tears can be bottled from a charged Respawn Anchor
spicedcider.ponder.nether_portal.text_6: Frames can be as large as 23 by 23 blocks
spicedcider.ponder.note_block.text_1: Note Blocks play a note when they get a flux pulse or are punched
spicedcider.ponder.note_block.text_2: Right-click to raise the pitch, stepping through two octaves
spicedcider.ponder.note_block.text_3: The block underneath picks the instrument
spicedcider.ponder.note_block.text_4: Wood gives a bass, Stone a drum, Sand a snare, Gold a bell and Packed Ice chimes
spicedcider.ponder.note_block.text_5: A mob head on top plays that mob's sound instead
spicedcider.ponder.observer.text_1: Observers watch the block in front of their face
spicedcider.ponder.observer.text_2: Whenever that block changes, they send a short pulse out of their back
spicedcider.ponder.observer.text_3: Crops growing, doors opening and blocks being placed or broken all count
spicedcider.ponder.pinecone_golem.text_1: A Carved Pumpkin placed on top of a Pinecone builds a Pinecone Golem
spicedcider.ponder.pinecone_golem.text_2: Hand it a Sapling and it carries it off
spicedcider.ponder.pinecone_golem.text_3: It plants the Sapling wherever there's room for a tree to grow
spicedcider.ponder.pinecone_golem.text_4: With empty hands it follows anyone holding a Sapling and picks up Saplings lying nearby
spicedcider.ponder.repeater.header: Delaying and locking signals with Repeaters
spicedcider.ponder.repeater.text_1: Repeaters carry a signal forward and boost it back to full strength
spicedcider.ponder.repeater.text_2: Right-click to set a delay between 1 and 4 flux ticks
spicedcider.ponder.repeater.text_3: Signals only travel through them one way
spicedcider.ponder.repeater.text_4: A powered Repeater or Comparator pointing into its side locks it
spicedcider.ponder.repeater.text_5: While locked, it keeps its output no matter what its input does
spicedcider.ponder.salt_spikes.text_1: Hang Pointed Dripstone under a block of Rock Salt
spicedcider.ponder.salt_spikes.text_2: With Water on top of the Rock Salt, the dripstone starts to drip
spicedcider.ponder.salt_spikes.text_3: Over time a Salt Spike grows on the floor below the tip
spicedcider.ponder.salt_spikes.text_4: Only one spike grows under each tip until it is broken
spicedcider.ponder.snow_golem.text_1: Two Snow Blocks topped with a Carved Pumpkin make a Snow Golem
spicedcider.ponder.snow_golem.text_2: Snow Golems pelt monsters with snowballs and leave snow wherever they walk
spicedcider.ponder.snow_golem.text_3: They melt in warm biomes and are hurt by water and rain
spicedcider.ponder.sputter.text_1: A Carved Pumpkin on top of a Barrel makes a Sputter
spicedcider.ponder.sputter.text_2: Load it with a stack of Arrows and it shoots at nearby monsters
spicedcider.ponder.sputter.text_4: Use an empty hand to take the Arrows back
spicedcider.ponder.sputter.text_5: A Dye gives it war paint
spicedcider.ponder.straw_golem.text_1: A Carved Pumpkin on top of a Hay Bale makes a Straw Golem
spicedcider.ponder.straw_golem.text_2: It harvests fully grown crops nearby...
spicedcider.ponder.straw_golem.text_4: The harvest goes into the nearest container
spicedcider.ponder.straw_golem.text_5: Sneak and use an empty hand on the golem, then on a container, to choose where it delivers
spicedcider.ponder.straw_golem.text_6: A Sun Hat keeps the rain off its head
spicedcider.ponder.straw_golem.text_7: A Barrel lets it shrug off hits
spicedcider.ponder.straw_golem.text_8: Wheat patches it up when it gets hurt
spicedcider.ponder.tag.golems.descriptio: Blocks that can be built into living helpers, or something worse
spicedcider.ponder.tag.multiblocks.descr: Blocks that only work as part of a larger structure
spicedcider.ponder.tag.redstone_componen: Blocks that send, shape or react to flux signals
spicedcider.ponder.tapping.text_1: Taps draw sap out of tree trunks
spicedcider.ponder.tapping.text_2: The trunk has to belong to a natural tree, with its leaves still attached
spicedcider.ponder.tapping.text_3: Place a Cauldron up to 3 blocks below the tap to catch what drips out
spicedcider.ponder.tapping.text_4: Over time the cauldron slowly fills up
spicedcider.ponder.tapping.text_5: Maple gives Maple Syrup, Spruce and Pine give Resin, and Kapok gives Latex
spicedcider.ponder.tapping.text_6: Tapping a full Beehive or Bee Nest collects Honey
spicedcider.ponder.tapping.text_7: Mortars and Basins can catch the drips as well
spicedcider.ponder.tapping.text_8: Right-click the tap to close or open it
spicedcider.ponder.tuning_fork_golems.te: Right-click a Copper Golem with a Tuning Fork to start conducting it
Right-click a block to send the golem there
Right-click the golem again to let it go
Used in the air, the fork rings out towards the nearest geode
spicedcider.ponder.weeping_obsidian.head: Collecting Dimensional Tears
spicedcider.ponder.weeping_obsidian.text: Crying Obsidian slowly weeps Dimensional Tears
A Cauldron below it catches the Tears, as long as there is only air in between
Collect them with a Glass Bottle or a Bucket
Every kind of Crying Obsidian weeps, including Bricks, Pillars and Polished
spicedcider.ponder.wither.text_1: Soul Sand or Soul Soil in a T shape forms the Wither's body
spicedcider.ponder.wither.text_2: Three Wither Skeleton Skulls on top summon it
spicedcider.ponder.wither.text_3: It explodes as it wakes, then attacks everything alive and breaks blocks in its way
spicedcider.ponder.wither.text_4: Summon it far from anything you want to keep
spicedcider.respawn_blocked: The Respawn Anchor is unresponsive in this dimension
